name: Timberling Sprouts
label: Quest
description: Around Lake Al'Ameth, Timberling Sprouts are spreading across Teldrassil. Denalan asks you to uproot them before they grow into hostile timberlings.

clips.title: The story
paras: Around Lake Al'Ameth, Timberling Sprouts are spreading across Teldrassil. Denalan asks you to uproot them before they grow into hostile timberlings.

Corrupted sprouts are spreading along Lake Al'Ameth's banks. Denalan lives beside the lake and knows these young plants cannot be healed. Left alone, they quickly grow into aggressive, bark-covered timberlings that threaten wildlife and travelers. Uprooting the sprouts helps protect the grove.
Denalan is troubled by how quickly new sprouts appear across Teldrassil. Their spread points to a sickness in the World Tree's roots and soil, and Denalan and the druids of Darnassus seek its cause.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Small timberlings are sprouting around the waters of Lake Al'Ameth. I'm afraid these sprouts are beyond help -- we should try to clear them from the land before they grow large enough to cause trouble.
When you're wandering the lake, if you see any timberling sprouts please take them. Help keep our land clean!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, friend. Have you found any sprouts near the waters?

clips.title: Completion
paras: That's a lot! I'm afraid they're spreading at a dangerous rate. I hope I can solve the riddle of what is tainting them.
Thank you for your help, friend. The land is a cleaner place from your efforts.
